verdict.rationale: Offloading to a hosted cloud tier is a fair question for a local inference runtime, but the evidence shows no vendor-hosted cloud tier. The closest items are self-hosted distributed GPU worker nodes and the option to point external gRPC backends at a remote URL. Both are user-run infrastructure or developer building blocks, not a hosted offload service, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can offload very large models to a hosted cloud tier without downloading them when my local hardware is insufficient
